{
  "up": [
    "Select activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id",
    "Join activities ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = activities.molregno",
    "Join molecule_dictionary ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno",
    "Join assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "Join target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid",
    "Filter activities.assay_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'",
    "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='",
    "Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL",
    "Filter activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL",
    "Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units",
    "Return canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units"
  ]
}
